title: Client organizations
purpose: Find the organizations the laboratory serves and open their contact details, contacts and portal accounts.
summary: The organizations the laboratory serves. Open one to see its contacts and portal accounts.

tasks.title: Find an organization
steps: Type a name, account code, email, phone or city in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].
Select the organization's name to open its page.

tasks.title: Add an organization
steps: Select [[New organization]], enter at least the name, and save. Then add its contacts.

tasks.title: Find organizations nobody can be reached at
steps: Set [[Status]] to Active, open [[More filters]], choose [[No active contact]] in [[Contacts]] and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: List organizations in one state
steps: Open [[More filters]], choose the [[State]] and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: List organizations of one type
steps: Open [[More filters]], choose the [[Organization type]] and select [[Apply]].

good_to_know: Every staff role can read this list. Only account managers and client services staff, and the admin role, add and change organizations.
An inactive organization stays in the list and keeps its records and history.
Search does not look at contacts' names, the mailing address lines or internal notes.
Organization type is a filter only. It is not a column of this list; the organization's page shows it.
Selecting an email address opens your email application. Nothing is sent from here.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches the organization name, account code, general email, main phone or city, ignoring case. It does not search contacts, street address lines, ZIP code or notes.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses and All include active and inactive organizations. Active or Inactive filters on the organization's Active setting.

items.label: Organization type
items.description: More filters: Any type or one organization type (Healthcare facility or system, Physician practice or clinic, Referring laboratory, Employer or program administrator, Utility or municipality, Engineering or consulting firm, Manufacturer or food producer, Research sponsor or institution, Internal department, Other). Organizations with no recorded type do not match a chosen type.

items.label: State
items.description: More filters: Any state or one state of the organization's mailing address (the 50 states, the District of Columbia and the territories, shown by name). Organizations with no recorded state do not match a chosen state.

items.label: Contacts
items.description: More filters: Any contacts, or No active contact, which keeps only organizations without an active contact. The dashboard queue Active organizations without an active contact opens this list with that filter.

items.label: New organization
items.description: Account managers, client services staff and the admin role create an organization here. Hidden from other staff roles; the server refuses their requests too.

items.label: Organization row link
items.description: Opens the organization's page. Select the Client organizations breadcrumb there to return to the same search, filters, sort and page.

items.label: Email link
items.description: Opens your email application; this page does not send an email.

items.label: Organization
items.description: The organization's name; default sort is name ascending. Always shown.

items.label: Account code
items.description: The laboratory's short code for the organization, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active or Inactive. Sortable.

items.label: Email
items.description: The general email address, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: Phone
items.description: The main phone, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: City, State
items.description: Mailing address city and state, or a dash. Each is sortable.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: Active staff can read this list; client portal accounts cannot. Invalid filters show errors and no rows until corrected or cleared. Invalid page sizes are refused. No-match and no-record empty states give different next steps. Inactive organizations remain part of searches.

items.label: Filter and sort (phones)
items.description: On a phone the search, filters, Apply, Clear all, Columns and the sort links are behind one Filter and sort button, so the rows come first. The button shows how many filters are active, and a line under it summarizes the filters and the current sort. Removable filter chips are not shown on a phone; Clear all is in the sheet. Wider screens show the toolbar as usual.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines the search and the selected filters across the complete record set and returns to page 1.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens the Organization type, State and Contacts filters and stays open while any of them is active or invalid.

items.label: Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered address and default sort. Removing one chip clears that criterion, keeps the others and returns to page 1.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort all matching records, not just this page. Unsupported sort values use the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder columns. The Organization column stays visible. The preference is saved for your account; it does not change data, search or sort. Reset columns restores the defaults.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 25, 50 or 100. Changing the size returns to page 1. Use Show when automatic submission is unavailable.

items.label: Pagination
items.description: First, Previous, Next and Last keep the filters and sort. The footer gives the visible range and the total matching count.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show a column or uncheck to hide it. Columns marked Always shown are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves a column within the displayed order. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table's default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved. No record is changed.
